latin: Non introducitur uegetalis anima ante sensualem, nec sensualis ante rationalem, sed tota simul.
translation: The vegetative soul is not introduced prior to the sensitive soul, nor the sensitive prior to the rational, but the whole soul is introduced at one and the same time.
